newsitem.title: UK: Britain welcomes Serbian move on opposition gains.
newsitem.headline: Britain welcomes Serbian move on opposition gains.

text.p: Britain on Tuesday welcomed the Serbian parliament's passing of a law reinstating opposition victories in local elections last November.

"I welcome the step taken today by the Serbian parliament. The Serbian authorities must now implement this legislation and reinstate opposition victories without further delay," Sir Nicholas Bonsor, a British foreign office minister, said in a statement.
Britain "will continue to encourage further democratisation in Serbia -- including through our support for the independent media," he added.
Earlier on Tuesday, the Serbian parliament passed a special law reinstating in principle the opposition victories in 14 towns and cities.
President Slobodan Milosevic's Socialists had annulled them on grounds of unspecified "irregularities", prompting months of mass protests and an international outcry.
